STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_04512_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_04512_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_04512 (
    address,
    chipselect,
    clk,
    in_port,
    reset_n,
    write_n,
    writedata,
    irq,
    out_port,
    readdata
);

  output          irq;
  output [31:0]   out_port;
  output [31:0]   readdata;
  input  [2:0]    address;
  input           chipselect;
  input           clk;
  input  [31:0]   in_port;
  input           reset_n;
  input           write_n;
  input  [31:0]   writedata;

  wire            clk_en;
  wire  [31:0]    data_in;
  reg   [31:0]    data_out;
  reg   [31:0]    irq_mask;
  wire  [31:0]    read_mux_out;
  reg   [31:0]    readdata;
  wire            wr_strobe;
  
  assign clk_en = 1;

  assign read_mux_out = ({32{(address == 0)}} & data_in) |
                        ({32{(address == 2)}} & irq_mask);

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (~reset_n)
      readdata <= 0;
    else if (clk_en)
      readdata <= read_mux_out;
  end

  assign wr_strobe = chipselect && ~write_n;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (~reset_n)
      data_out <= 0;
    else if (clk_en) begin
      if (wr_strobe) begin
        case (address)
          5: data_out <= data_out & ~writedata[31:0];
          4: data_out <= data_out | writedata[31:0];
          0: data_out <= writedata[31:0];
        endcase
      end
    end
  end

  assign out_port = data_out;
  assign data_in = in_port;

  always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (~reset_n)
      irq_mask <= 0;
    else if (chipselect && ~write_n && (address == 2))
      irq_mask <= writedata[31:0];
  end

  assign irq = |(data_in & irq_mask);

endmodule
